summary: Dallas-based contact referred by Kiel who reached out about regaining access to a locked Instagram account. He was locked out because the account was tied to an old phone number and video verification wouldn't work, even with two friend approvals and the correct password. Advised that Instagram goes by trusted devices, so he needs to get his old broken-screen phone temporarily revived (soft-install an LCD, ~$40-50 at a non-corporate repair shop) to add a new phone number. He was going to send a screenshot of local repair shops for help picking a non-corporate one — no payment or service sale was made.
key_facts: Locked out of IG: account linked to old phone number, video verification method fails
Already had 2 friends do the account approval; knows his password but still can't sign in
Instagram.com/hacked did not work for him
Has the old (trusted) device but the display is broken
Advised: pay a local phone repair shop ~$40-50 to soft-install an LCD just long enough to add a new phone number
Phone owner mentioned he owns phone repair shops; corporate shops won't do soft installs
Open follow-up: he was to send a screenshot of nearby repair shops so owner could point out which are non-corporate
No payment or paid service agreed
services_discussed: Instagram account recovery / regaining account access
Advice on trusted-device verification and adding a new phone number
Phone repair referral guidance (temporary LCD soft install)
